lines.text: We pigged out on pizza last night.

data.define: To eat a very large amount of food happily.

example.text: We pigged out on pizza last night.

misuse.text: Don't tell your host she made you 'pig out'.

publish.title: What does "pig out" mean?
publish.value: Pig out = Eat way too much. Example: "We pigged out on pizza last night." (casual English, US).
